delegation.description: Which sections managers can save on the resources below, and which sections request policies can set. Saved edits are allowed by default; request policies need permission. Organization policies cover every resource, folder policies their grants and keys, and grant policies their keys. Permissions intersect.

totalSeconds.description: Longest total wait, from when the gateway admits the request body. Defaults to 3600. Credential policies, and rules whose condition reads author, model, deployment, route or provider fields, cannot set it.

outputIdleSeconds.description: Longest wait for useful provider output, from each provider call and after each output. Defaults to 300. Each call uses the value for its own deployment and credential.

timeouts.description: For each timeout, the smallest required value applies. A timeout ends your wait; provider work that has started continues and is billed.

end.description: The end must be later than the start. Split an overnight period into two entries.

timeZone.description: UTC or an IANA time zone name with its exact capitalization, such as America/New_York.

access.description: Weekly periods when the gateway refuses requests.

asciiOnly.description: Reject non-ASCII decoded text in redaction-scanned input fields before redaction. Any parent requirement wins.

input.description: Checks on request text before redaction.

unit.description: Provider total tokens by default. STT is decoded input UTF-8 bytes divided by four, charged only for successful billable requests.

lifetimeUsd.description: Exact nonnegative USD, at most 36 decimal places and $1 trillion. No exponent or trailing fractional zeros.

maxUsd.description: Exact nonnegative USD, at most 36 decimal places and $1 trillion. No exponent or trailing fractional zeros.

timeZone.description: UTC or an IANA time zone name with its exact capitalization, such as America/New_York.

limits.description: At most 5 named limits per policy, across recurring spending, request rate and token limits. In a rule, lifetime and concurrency limits together count as one. Request policies cannot set limits.

url.description: Complete JSON webhook URL. No path is appended.

headers.description: Destination authentication headers. Encrypt the plugins section to keep these private when saved.

content.description: Send request and response bodies. Defaults to true; false sends the request record and metadata only.

destinations.description: Independent destinations from required policies are combined. Destinations with the same URL and headers are sent once, with bodies if any of them sends bodies. At most eight combined destinations. An empty array adds none and replaces plugin defaults.

stogasTextExtraction.description: Extract inline UTF-8 text attachments before input checks and redaction. Any required true setting enables extraction.

customPattern.description: One RE2 expression, limited to 512 UTF-8 bytes.

items.description: Exact text, up to 256 UTF-8 bytes. Not a regular expression.

values.description: Plain text strings, each at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Settings apply to every value.

fuzzy.description: Allow one ASCII insertion, deletion, substitution or adjacent swap

literals.description: Groups of literal strings sharing case, boundary and fuzzy settings. At most 1,000 strings and 65,536 UTF-8 text bytes in total.

stogasRedaction.description: An empty object adds no redaction and replaces redaction defaults. Required redaction from other policies still applies.

plugins.description: Text extraction, redaction and export of each request and response to your webhook. Encrypt their settings to keep them private.

allowedCatalogNodes.description: A candidate must match each list that is present. Lists share the policy byte budget. An empty object replaces default lists without removing other required lists.

retries.description: Calls to the same deployment and credential after a lost connection or a 408, 409, 429 or 5xx response, unless the provider's x-should-retry header says otherwise. Defaults to 0. The smallest value that applies wins.

fallbacks.description: Other deployment and credential pairs to try, in routing order, after a pair fails. Defaults to 2. The smallest value that applies wins. Credential policies, and rules whose condition reads author, model, deployment, route or provider fields, cannot set it.

filter.description: A CEL filter over catalog facts, request model, route and time. Input-token and cost estimates are unavailable during routing.

order.description: Deployment IDs to try first, in this order. Deployments the request cannot use are skipped. With routing.sort it forms one order, which organization, folder, grant, key and request policies can set at the top level or in one rule with mode default and no when. The broadest required order applies, otherwise the closest default. A request policy cannot change a saved required order.

by.description: A typed CEL expression. Prices use decimal("...") for exact values.

direction.description: Defaults to asc. Missing values sort last in either direction.

sort.description: Up to three criteria that order deployments after routing.order. Each orders the ties of the one before and must read an author, model, deployment, route or provider field. The last can be random() or random(weight), without a direction, for a weighted random order.

routing.description: Which deployments and credentials requests may use and in which order, and how often a request retries or falls back.

rules.description: Unordered named rules. Names identify conditional counters and never give precedence.

title: Stogas policy v1
description: Structural editor schema for saved resource policies (organization, folder, grant, role, member, credential, key). Scope controls root registration and delegation targets. Save-time validation checks readable fields, including query grammar, IANA time zones, RE2 safety and cross-field limits. Encrypted plugins are validated at execution. The 262144-byte content limit counts decoded plugin plaintext; storage allows bounded base64 overhead. Unknown properties are rejected.
